Provisional audit. Cached baseline verified: 11,356/12,197 tokens (93.10%), 443/485 exact totals (91.34%). Root-cause classifications are hypotheses pending visual confirmation. New inference reproduction and optimization have not been completed.

All evidence JSON · CSV · AI-readable index · Architecture audit · Experiments/status · Interim report

Every receipt JSON includes both OCR passes, boxes, confidence scores, ground truth, candidate evidence and original image URL. All links work without client-side JavaScript.
